description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for representing a date display field with aggregation capabilities in a reporting context. It uses a trait for date-time helper functions and implements a stringable interface for conversion to string.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayFieldWithAggregateDTO
classes.description: A DTO class for handling date display with aggregation in reports, utilizing helper traits and implementing string conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a date string, which is converted to a DateTime object if provided.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the formatted date as a string using the dateTime helper trait.
